title: Ada Was the Only One With a Plan the Whole Time
description: Mars possesses the village leader, Dick gets swarmed, and the enslaved girl Ada finally snaps. It does not go the way anyone expects.
hook_note: Picks up the instant the war-god lands, then immediately shows him hijacking a body - clear stakes, fast.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: So Mars, this washed-up war god, has just landed unseen in the village - and he spots the perfect body to steal. The leader, Wad.

segments.text: So Mars, this washed-up war god, has just landed unseen in the village - and he spots the perfect body to steal.
The leader, Wad.

shots.speaker: Mars
shots.line: This is my chance to destroy a civilization! I'll enter Wad's body!

segments.text: This is my chance to destroy a civilization!
I'll enter Wad's body!

shots.speaker: Wad
shots.line: How dare a stranger interfere with my people? Take this!

segments.text: How dare a stranger interfere with my people?
Take this!
Earthman's fist!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: One good punch, and then about forty hooded guys pile on. Certified problem-solver Dick Warren, overpowered.

segments.text: One good punch, and then about forty hooded guys pile on.
Certified problem-solver Dick Warren, overpowered.

shots.speaker: Wad
shots.line: Tonight we feast on your tender Earth-man's flesh! Tomorrow we invade the Hidden People!

segments.text: Tonight we feast on your tender Earth-man's flesh!
Tomorrow we invade the Hidden People!
Cannibals!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: But nobody's asked the actual MVP, Ada. She's been a slave to these people for years. And she's done.

segments.text: But nobody's asked the actual MVP, Ada.
She's been a slave to these people for years.
And she's done.

shots.speaker: Ada
shots.line: I have been a slave too long! Die!

segments.text: I have been a slave too long!
Die!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: She cuts Dick loose and drags him toward the mountain where the Hidden People live, with the whole tribe screaming behind them.

segments.text: She cuts Dick loose and drags him toward the mountain where the Hidden People live, with the whole tribe screaming behind them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: They stop in a cave to catch their breath. What they do not clock is the face watching them from the rocks.

segments.text: They stop in a cave to catch their breath.
What they do not clock is the face watching them from the rocks.
We're trapped!

cliffhanger_note: Tiny creatures are swarming Dick and Ada in the dark cave - who lives inside this mountain, and are they friend or foe?
